policies.name: Ban on identified single-use plastic items
policies.summary: Bans manufacture, sale, and use of 19 single-use plastic items including straws, cutlery, and thin plastic bags.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, India

newsFeed.headline: India's extended producer responsibility rules now cover all plastic packaging
newsFeed.summary: Updated rules require brand owners to collect and recycle a rising share of the plastic they put on the market, with penalties for non-compliance.

wooby.headline: India bans 19 kinds of single-use plastic — informal recyclers do the rest.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has heard that millions of waste-pickers in India sort plastic by hand every day. India banned plastic straws and thin bags in 2022. Cities like Mumbai are working hard, but a lot of plastic still escapes into rivers. Wooby is grateful for the recyclers.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, India
